subject: Clarify control sampling and evidence windows for FedRAMP/ISO roadmap
messages:
From: Ellen Park <security@northridgehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on sample sizes / evidence windows for upcoming readiness work

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As we prepare our internal checklist for the FedRAMP readiness engagement and the ISO 27001 alignment, a couple of clarification items came up from our security team that I'd like to confirm before we schedule the control walkthrough next week: 

- For controls that rely on audit logs (auth events, admin changes, key rotations), what is the effective evidence window you can provide? We typically need 12 months for ISO, but some FedRAMP assessments request a 6–12 month slice.
- How are you handling sampling for user provisioning/deprovisioning controls where customer org size varies? Do you pick random samples per customer or do you provide a sampling methodology we can rely on?
- For SIG/CAIQ questions that ask for system-level artifacts, can you provide CSV exports of the audit log and a mapping to the control IDs, or do you prefer we pull snapshots via API?

Also, we'll probably ask for a small sample set for the Hosted API and any Dedicated customers in-scope (North Ridge has both). Could you confirm who on your team will own the evidence pull and expected lead times?

I've attached our initial control matrix request (we'll refine after your answers).

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Security Manager — North Ridge Healthcare
security@northridgehealth.com

Attachment: Requested_Control_Matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <security@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on sample sizes / evidence windows for upcoming readiness work

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then some detail below: 

- Evidence window: we can provide 12 months of retained audit logs for Hosted API and Dedicated clusters by default; for Private/VPC installs retention depends on customer configuration but we'll surface whatever the customer has in the requested timeframe.
- Sampling approach: we provide a deterministic sampling methodology (randomized seed + strata by org size) and can either run the sample on our side and deliver artifacts or provide the sample criteria if you prefer to pull.
- Exports: CSV audit exports are fine. For privileged actions we recommend including full JSON log bundles (schema attached) for traceability.

Owner & timing: Marissa will be the evidence owner for the Hosted/Dedicated artifacts; typical lead time for a scoped sample is 5–7 business days after scope sign-off.

Below are specifics and a proposed timeline — attaching a short control_map_v1.xlsx with the mapping to our internal control IDs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: control_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ellen Park <security@northridgehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on sample sizes / evidence windows for upcoming readiness work

Thanks Kimberly — that helps. A couple of follow ups: 

- Scope: Confirming in-scope surfaces for North Ridge: Hosted API (including Console access) + Dedicated capacity for our production cluster. Private deployment is out of scope for this engagement.
- Retention: For ISO we'll ask for the full 12 months; for FedRAMP initial evidence we can accept a 6-month slice but may ask for 12 if sampling variance is high.
- CSV vs JSON: CSV exports are fine for initial review; for any admin/privileged events we'll request the full JSON bundles for the sampled records.

One more ask — can you confirm whether encryption key rotation logs include the KMS key id and rotation timestamp in the exported schema? If not, we may need an alternate evidence item.

On the sampling front, we'll plan a stratified sample: 30 records for orgs <1k users, 50 for 1k–10k, and 100+ for >10k. Does that align with your recommendation?

Ellen

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <security@northridgehealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on sample sizes / evidence windows for upcoming readiness work

Ellen — adding a few technical clarifications from the infra side: 

- KMS/key rotation: our key rotation records (for hosted keys) include KMS key id, rotate actor, and UTC timestamp. For Dedicated customers using their own KMS, we capture the rotation event metadata that the customer exposes; if North Ridge uses an external KMS we may need a short consent window to request logs.
- Audit log export: Console -> Audit -> Export will give you CSV slices with a consistent schema (we linked the schema in the related_links). For full event payloads we can export newline-delimited JSON for the sampled record ids.
- Sampling tool: we use the internal sample generator (seeded) and will provide a reproducible seed and manifest.csv that lists the selected record ids and why they were chosen.

Proposed sample sizes look reasonable; if you want to increase to 40/60/120 that's fine but will increase collection time by ~2 business days.

I'll coordinate the data pulls once scope is final.

—Marissa
Manager, Infrastructure Security
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <security@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 14:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed schedule + control mapping and next steps

Ellen — based on your confirmation of Hosted + Dedicated in-scope, and the sampling size you proposed, here's our suggested plan: 

1) Scope sign-off by Tue 2026-06-30 (North Ridge security reply)
2) Redwood produces manifest and sample seed by Fri 2026-07-03
3) Artifact collection window: 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-10 (5 business days)
4) Evidence handoff: secure Drive folder + audit manifest by 2026-07-12

Attached: Requested_Control_Matrix_v2.xlsx (this maps our internal control ids to your SIG/ISO questions and flags items that need cust consent).

A few action items for you: confirm scope (Hosted + Dedicated), confirm final sample sizes, and confirm whether North Ridge will provide Dedicated KMS logs or ask Redwood to proxy them.

We can expedite if you need a pre-audit snapshot sooner — let us know the cut-off date.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachment: Requested_Control_Matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Isaac Cohen <isaac@thirdparty-audit.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Ellen Park <security@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on sample sizes / evidence windows for upcoming readiness work

Kimberly/Ellen — quick note from the assessor side: the approach looks good. A few items to confirm before we lock the plan: 

- EU customers: if a sample includes any EU-based accounts, we typically require the sample size + 20% to account for cross-border variance. If North Ridge is strictly US, the current sample sizes are fine.
- Encryption evidence: please include KMS key id, rotation events, and the associated CMK policy snapshot for each sampled rotation event. If Redwood can provide the CMK policy export that would be ideal.
- Snapshot for pre-audit: we recommend a one-time system snapshot (read-only) dated 2026-07-01 to be preserved for the assessment run.

If Redwood can confirm preservation of a 2026-07-01 snapshot and provide the requested KMS metadata, we can proceed with the proposed schedule.

I'll be available next week for a short call to finalize the manifest if helpful.

—Isaac Cohen
Principal Assessor — ThirdParty Audit Co.
isaac@thirdparty-audit.com
